title: adiantum trapeziforme var. pentadactylon
intro: Adiantum trapeziforme var. pentadactylon, commonly known as maidenhair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Adiantaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Adiantum trapeziforme var. pentadactylon include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and the reduction of inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
